verdict.rationale: Aider is a local CLI coding agent. Its documented context features are adding files to a chat, building a repo map of a single local git repo, and scraping web pages into a session. None of these is a shared team workspace that combines docs and repos into a common source of truth. They are adjacent, single-user session features at most, and no evidence shows any team or shared-workspace capability.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
